Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 112: August 2010
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #112 shipped to subscribers in July 2010 (bearing the cover date of August 2010 for Issue 112). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #112 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Dead Rising 2 (open-world action survival horror)
Enslaved: Odyssey to the West (tactical action-adventure)
Hawx 2 (arcade flight combat)
Shank (Xbox Live Arcade 2D side-scrolling beat 'em up)
Space Invaders Infinity Gene (Xbox Live Arcade arcade shoot 'em up)
Scott Pilgrim vs. The World: The Game (Xbox Live Arcade retro beat 'em up)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for Call of Duty: Black Ops, Halo: Reach, and Portal 2, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
